fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria:
Given an order whose payment succeeded, when the confirmation email job runs, then the email is sent within 2 minutes with the invoice PDF attached.

Given the order API response, when the invoice PDF is rendered, then line items with unit prices, per-item VAT rate, and gross total match GET /orders/{id} exactly.

Given a hard-bouncing recipient address, when the confirmation email is sent, then it is retried once after 5 minutes and then written to the mail audit log (no silent loss).

Given an invoice rendering failure, when the confirmation email job runs, then the email is still sent without the attachment and the failure appears on the alerting dashboard (no customer-visible error).
fields.System.Description:
Context: Customers receive a plain-text order confirmation with no price breakdown. The order service already returns complete invoice data (GET /orders/{id}: line items, unit prices, VAT rates, totals).

Reason: B2B customers and expense claims require a formal invoice document. Top request from B2B account managers this quarter; order data is complete, so this is rendering + attachment only.

Scope: This story adds invoice rendering and email attachment. Out of scope: credit notes, self-service invoice re-download from the account page.
fields.System.Title: Invoice PDF in order confirmation email
